# Temple Scroll Column 9 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 11QT (Cave 11), Col. 9 | **Condition:** Fragmentary; Wood Offering Festival continues

---

**9:1** [...] on the third day, Simeon and Benjamin [...]

**9:2** [...] on the fourth day, Issachar and Zebulun [...]

**9:3** [...] on the fifth day, Gad and Asher [...]

**9:4** [...] on the sixth day, Dan and Naphtali [...]

**9:5** [...] they will bring wood for the altar [...]

**9:6** [...] each tribe must bring its share [...] on its assigned day [...]

**9:7** [...] the priests and Levites will lay it on the fire [...]

**9:8** [...] on the altar of burnt offering [...]

**9:9** [...] this is the day of the wood [offering ...] a permanent law [...]

**9:10** [...] for all generations [...] in the presence of the LORD [...]

**9:11** [...] the fire on the altar must never be allowed to go out [...]

**9:12** [...] it must burn without ceasing [...]

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 9 completes the six-day wood offering schedule. Each pair of tribes brings wood on their assigned day: Simeon and Benjamin (day 3), Issachar and Zebulun (day 4), Gad and Asher (day 5), Dan and Naphtali (day 6). The final lines mandate a perpetual altar fire (echoing Lev 6:13), which the wood offering directly sustains.*
